text:
maria: Quick thread — proposal for a 'strangler' shim to migrate clients off /v1/legacy -> /v2/standard. Goal: zero-downtime, per-tenant opt-in, clear error mapping.

kevin: @maria curious about scope — is this proxy-only or are we also rewriting payloads?

maria: It will be a lightweight proxy that rewrites the v1 envelope into the v2 shape, maps auth headers, and routes based on a tenant migration flag. Fallback semantics: if v2 errors we can fall back to the legacy handler for a short window. Telemetry emits migration_phase=proxy.

sasha: :thinking_face: two quick concerns — added latency on hot paths and silent semantic skew if we auto-fallback. We should avoid masking regressions.

albert: Agree with @sasha. Proposal: add per-tenant mode (strict vs fail-open) and make fallback explicit. Also we need a clear error-mapping policy — don't collapse 5xx into 4xx.

maria: Good call. Plan: default strict for canary tenants; fail-open for low-risk tenants. Error mapping rules: preserve 4xx semantics; for upstream 5xx return 502 and include original upstream id in X-Upstream-Error header. We'll log full request/response for repro to private S3 (opt-in only).

tay: Auth question — v1 uses X-API-Key, v2 expects Bearer JWT with audience. How will we bridge that without storing user secrets?

maria: Auth bridge: validate incoming api key against internal AuthN service, then mint a short-lived service JWT using token-exchange. No user creds persisted. Every exchange is audit-logged.

kevin: Testing matrix? I'm thinking unit contract tests, shadow traffic, staged canaries, and chaos tests for header loss/timeout.

maria: Yep: contract tests + shadow mode (48h at 10% traffic), then opt-in cutover per tenant, then 100% for opted tenants. Rollback via feature flag + circuit-breaker in the proxy.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deploy queued: shim-proxy v0.1 -> staging at 7301112260 :rocket:

sasha: Docs/comms: migration guide with example header mappings, error examples, and a checklist for tenants. Observability: add a metric for translated_requests/sec and a regression alert on increase in user-visible errors.

albert: Adding a config snippet for the mapping to the RFC addendum: ```json
{"route_mapping": [{"from": "/v1/generate", "to": "/v2/completions", "rewrite": {"envelope": "v1->v2"}}]}```

maria: Owners: maria (lead), kevin (tests + rollout), sasha (observability + alerts), albert (auth bridge), tay (docs). Next actions: open PR for shim, RFC addendum with error-mapping table, and tickets for telemetry. I'll create the tickets today.

kevin: :thumbsup: thanks!
